receptor_A.function_summary: Tyrosine-protein kinase receptor for FGF ligands. Phosphorylates PLCG1, FRS2, GAB1, SHB. Activates RAS-MAPK, PI3K-AKT, and PLCgamma signaling cascades.

receptor_B.family: Cytokine receptor (type I, gp130 family, JAK-STAT signal transducer)
receptor_B.kinase_domain: No intrinsic kinase domain; constitutively associated with JAK1/JAK2/TYK2
receptor_B.function_summary: Signal-transducing subunit (gp130) for IL-6 family cytokines. Homodimerization activates JAK-MAPK and JAK-STAT3 pathways. Also activates YAP and NOTCH pathways.

fgfr1.aged_expression: maintained in aged MuSC (PMID:41462267, PMID:41756900, PMID:32103583)
fgfr1.note: FGFR1 is essential for satellite cell quiescence and regeneration; expression is maintained in aged muscle stem cells

il6st.aged_expression: broadly expressed in skeletal muscle across age groups
il6st.note: gp130 is the shared signal transducer for IL-6 family; expressed in satellite cells, myofibers, and FAPs

expression_in_aged_muscle.co_expression_verdict: PASS — both receptors expressed in aged skeletal muscle target cells

receptor_family_check.fgfr1: RTK — canonical forced-proximity class (H2F template compatible)
receptor_family_check.il6st: Cytokine receptor (JAK-associated) — non-RTK but mechanistically compatible with transphosphorylation via JAK kinase activity
receptor_family_check.verdict: VALID — RTK + cytokine receptor pair. FGFR1 provides intrinsic tyrosine kinase; IL6ST provides JAK-associated kinase activity. Transphosphorylation can occur bidirectionally: FGFR1 kinase can phosphorylate IL6ST cytoplasmic tyrosines, and JAK1/2 associated with IL6ST can phosphorylate FGFR1 tyrosines.
receptor_family_check.note: This is an RTK-cytokine receptor chimera pair. While not a pure RTK-RTK pair like H2F, the forced proximity enables bidirectional transphosphorylation between FGFR1's intrinsic kinase and JAK1/2 bound to IL6ST's Box1/Box2 motifs.

linker_geometry.implications: The flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å) brings the two receptors into close proximity. The moderate ECD asymmetry (244 aa difference) means the kinase domains are offset but the flexible linker can accommodate this. The close proximity favors transphosphorylation over cis-autophosphorylation.

pdb_structures.il6st_cytoplasmic: no full-length structure; JAK-binding Box1/Box2 motifs characterized biochemically

transphosphorylation_feasibility.fgfr1_kinase_phosphorylates_il6st: HIGH — FGFR1 is a promiscuous tyrosine kinase that can phosphorylate JAK-associated receptors. FGFR1 is known to phosphorylate STAT3 directly (PMID:20388777) and interacts with JAK2 (PMID:20388777).
transphosphorylation_feasibility.jak_phosphorylates_fgfr1: HIGH — JAK2 interacts with FGFR1 (BioGRID:513671). JAKs can phosphorylate RTK cytoplasmic domains.
transphosphorylation_feasibility.verdict: Bidirectional transphosphorylation is mechanistically feasible. FGFR1 kinase phosphorylates IL6ST tyrosines (STAT3 docking sites), while JAK1/2 associated with IL6ST phosphorylate FGFR1 tyrosines (FRS2/PLCG1 docking sites).

transphosphorylation: GRB2 — recruited to phosphorylated FRS2 (FGFR1 substrate) and SHC1; drives RAS-MAPK
SHC1 — phosphorylated by FGFR1 kinase; recruits GRB2-SOS1
FRS2 — constitutive FGFR1 adaptor; phosphorylated by FGFR1 kinase; recruits GRB2, GAB1, PIK3R1, SOS1
GAB1 — recruited to phosphorylated FRS2; scaffolds PI3K and SHP2
PIK3R1 — p85 regulatory subunit of PI3K; recruited to phosphorylated FRS2/GAB1
SOS1 — recruited via GRB2 to activate RAS
STAT3 — directly phosphorylated by FGFR1 kinase (PMID:20388777) and by JAKs; the IL6ST-STAT3 axis is the canonical downstream effector
cis: JAK1 — constitutively associated with IL6ST Box1/Box2; autophosphorylates upon IL6ST clustering
JAK2 — interacts with FGFR1 (BioGRID:513671); can phosphorylate FGFR1
TYK2 — secondary JAK family member associated with IL6ST
excluded: PLCG1 — requires specific docking at FGFR1 pY766. Under forced proximity with IL6ST, the ~244 aa ECD asymmetry and ~20 Å GS4 linker create a geometry where the PLCG1 SH2 domain cannot simultaneously access pY766 on FGFR1 while the IL6ST cytoplasmic domain occupies the space. This is analogous to PLCG1 exclusion in H2F.

biased_pathways: JAK-STAT3 (via JAK1/2 phosphorylation of IL6ST tyrosines → STAT3 recruitment and phosphorylation)
biased_output.mechanism_narrative: The FGFR1-IL6ST forced-proximity novokine with a flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å) brings an RTK (FGFR1) and a cytokine receptor (IL6ST/gp130) into close physical proximity, enabling bidirectional transphosphorylation. FGFR1's intrinsic tyrosine kinase phosphorylates IL6ST's cytoplasmic tyrosines (creating STAT3 docking sites) and FRS2 (recruiting GRB2-SOS1-RAS-MAPK and GAB1-PI3K-AKT). Reciprocally, JAK1/2 constitutively associated with IL6ST's Box1/Box2 motifs phosphorylate FGFR1 tyrosines, amplifying SHC1 and FRS2 recruitment. The biased output is synergistic MAPK + PI3K/AKT + STAT3 activation, while PLCG1 is sterically excluded due to the ECD asymmetry (353 vs 597 aa) and short linker geometry. This triple-axis output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, STAT3↑) promotes proliferation, survival, mitochondrial biogenesis, and muscle regeneration — a transcriptional program enriched in young skeletal muscle — while suppressing PLCγ-Ca2+ signaling.

predicted_gene_rationale.up: MAPK activation drives muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2) and NOTCH3 (satellite cell self-renewal). PI3K-AKT upregulates CCND1 (cell cycle), MYC (proliferation), and BCL2 (survival). STAT3 activation induces SOCS3 (feedback regulator). These are enriched in the P2_up (young-enriched) signature from the muscle aging atlas, consistent with the past wins pattern.
predicted_gene_rationale.down: Aged immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and stress/senescence markers (TXNIP, IL32, CDKN2A, IL6) are suppressed. MYF5 (myogenic commitment) and MYH9 (non-muscle myosin) are reduced as the cell shifts toward a more mature/youthful myogenic program. This mirrors the past wins pattern where aged IEGs and inflammatory markers go down.

mechanism_narrative: FGFR1-IL6ST forced-proximity novokine with flexible GS4 linker enables bidirectional transphosphorylation between an RTK (FGFR1) and a cytokine receptor (IL6ST/gp130). FGFR1 kinase phosphorylates IL6ST tyrosines (STAT3 docking) and FRS2 (MAPK/PI3K recruitment). JAK1/2 from IL6ST reciprocally phosphorylate FGFR1 tyrosines (SHC1/FRS2 amplification). The biased output is synergistic MAPK↑ + PI3K/AKT↑ + STAT3↑, while PLCG1 is sterically excluded by the ~244 aa ECD asymmetry. This triple-axis signaling promotes muscle structural gene expression and suppresses aged inflammatory/IEG programs.
